{{Top|leg}}
The '''F-57 Nucleon''' was a type of [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]]. It sported inertial stabilizers and a Class Three [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive. Its design was a charming sort of retro, with a forward cab, a one-piece windscreen and sweeping tail fins.<ref name="sos">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

The [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Dejah Duare]] owned one such skimmer during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="sos" />
